seo.title: Support Request — Jobsite Systems
seo.description: Quick support form for current Jobsite Systems clients. Tell us what's going on with your site and we'll triage your request.

header.heading: Support Request
header.lead: Site acting up? Need a content edit? Tell us what's going on. Urgent issues get same-day replies during business hours; everything else lands within one business day.

form.subject: Support request — jobsite.systems
form.successMessage: Got it. We'll triage and reply — urgent issues are same-day during business hours.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly at hello@jobsite.systems.

fields.name: issue_title
fields.label: What's the issue?
fields.placeholder: Short name — e.g. "Estimate form not sending emails" or "Update service area on home page"

options.label: Something's broken
options.description: Site is down, a feature stopped working, error showing up.

options.label: Content edit
options.description: Update copy, swap a photo, change a service-area town, fix a typo.

options.label: Feature request
options.description: Want to add something new — a page, section, or capability.

options.label: Billing question
options.description: Invoice, plan change, payment method, cancellation.

options.label: Other
options.description: Doesn't fit the buckets above. Describe in the notes below.

options.label: Urgent
options.description: Site is down or it's actively losing estimate requests. Same-day during business hours.

options.label: Normal
options.description: Soon would be great, but not on fire. Within one business day.

options.label: Whenever
options.description: No rush. Get to it when you can.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Tell us more
fields.placeholder: What were you trying to do, what happened instead, what device/browser you're on if it's a bug. The more context, the faster we can fix it.

fields.name: human_check
fields.label: Type the number above to confirm you're human

fields.name: terms
fields.label: I agree to the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy, and consent to being contacted about this support request.
